note: Santa Clara County Parks campground on an open bench at the south end of Coyote Lake, in the hills east of Gilroy. Paved hookup sites (water and electric) in the south loop; RVs that fit (11 ft high max) may also use the drive-in tent sites to the north. No gates; arrive by 10 p.m. Boating on the 449-acre lake runs mid-April to mid-October. --Claude
summary: Coyote Lake - Lakeview (Santa Clara County): county fee, RV, tent, reservation and park pages via the headless browser (all 403 to curl) + campground map via Wayback + Esri/3DEP. $53 is only the hookup-site rate; tent sites take RVs at $41, so the price gate passes (nightly_low 41). Added 73 sites (19 RV + 54), 30-ft/11-ft limits, $10 extra vehicle, 8-person cap, off-peak 25% note, operator engine. Lakeview kept; possible lakefront lead on sites 29/30/32/34.
flags: PRICE GATE: the stored $53 is the peak water-and-electric RV-site rate, over US$50. The county says RVs may also park 'at an accommodating tent campsite' and marks Coyote Lake 'Yes' for that; those sites are $41 peak (both drop 25% Nov 1-Feb 28/29, to $39.75 and $30.75). nightly_low set to 41, so the entry passes the gate on the no-hookup option. No drop proposed.

WATERFRONT LEAD (no change made, stored 'lakeview' kept): the county campground map draws Coyote Lake ~45-60 m east of tent sites 29, 30, 32 and 34, over open grass, and those sites are sold by the night. 3DEP puts the loop at ~241.5 m and the grass at 238.5 m (37.0821,-121.5312) and 236.2 m (37.0828,-121.5316), but I could not find the reservoir's full-pool or spillway elevation, so the high-water edge isn't measured. The imagery shows the reservoir drawn far down (bare lakebed from ~37.0835; water at 230.94 m on 3DEP). Approx. site area 37.0815,-121.5298. Unproven, so not raised.
SITES: max_rig_ft 30 is the county's posted RV limit ('11' H X 30' L'); a 23-ft rig is within it, and EKKO's height (<10.5 ft) is under the 11-ft limit.
HOOKUPS: 19 hookup sites (the map's 1-18 plus 5A/5B), not the 18 the old note said; electric is present but its amperage isn't published, so hookups.electric is left unset.
PHONE: stored 408-355-2201 is the county reservations office (weekdays). The park office is (408) 842-7800. Either is defensible; no change required.
STATUS: boating closed for the season as of 2026-10-16 (seasonal; campground not named as closed).
UNREAD: the gooutsideandplay.org engine's site list and booking window (not walked); the live campground-map PDF (403; Wayback 2025-03 capture used for the layout only).
